hero.subtitle: Screen, file and print watermarking with screen and application control, delivered by ADP: closing the screen, print and file gap that legacy DLP leaves open.

challenge.title: The gap legacy DLP leaves open
challenge.body: Legacy DLP leaves a gap at the screen, the printer and the file itself. Data shown in a meeting, captured from a screen, printed or exported to PDF needs to stay traceable to its source.
points: Data shared in virtual and in-person meetings
Print Screen, snipping tools and screen capture
Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files

opportunity.title: Every screen, file and printout traceable to its source
opportunity.body: Data watermarking makes every screen, file and printout traceable to its source, and blocks screen sharing and capture of critical applications. It maps directly to NCA's Data Cybersecurity Controls on meetings, screen capture and document watermarking, and to the ECC labelling requirement.

capabilities.title: Screen watermark
capabilities.body: Visible watermark on screens and inside applications.

capabilities.title: File watermark
capabilities.body: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF, applied automatically with integrity monitoring.

capabilities.title: Print watermark
capabilities.body: Custom pattern on every print and PDF export.

capabilities.title: Screen control
capabilities.body: Blocks unauthorised screen sharing and capture of critical apps; every attempt recorded.

capabilities.title: Application control
capabilities.body: Blocks snipping tools, PrintScreen and unauthorised apps, with time-stamped audit.

applications.title: Virtual and in-person meetings
applications.body: Secure handling of data when it is shown in a meeting.

applications.title: Devices processing documents
applications.body: Print Screen and screen capture disabled where documents are processed.

applications.title: Documents through their lifecycle
applications.body: Watermarks on creation, storage, printing and screen, traceable to user or device.

applications.title: Data labelling by classification
applications.body: Automated labelling by classification, including watermarks.

outcomes.label: At unauthorised screen sharing or capture recorded

vision2030.body: Supports NCA data cybersecurity controls, and is also aligned with SDAIA PDPL, ISO/IEC 27002, PCI-DSS, NIST and GCC data-protection laws.

deployment.note: Offered as a per-user or per-endpoint subscription, applied on the devices that process your documents.

extras.title: Saudi NCA controls addressed
items: DCC 1-3-1-3: secure handling of data in virtual and in-person meetings
DCC 2-2-1-4: disable Print Screen and screen capture on devices processing documents
DCC 2-4-1-1: watermark documents on creation, storage, printing and screen, traceable to user or device
ECC 2-7-3-2: automate data labelling by classification, including watermarks
